details.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano (30B-A3B) is a hybrid Mamba-2/Transformer Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model from NVIDIA, released December 15, 2025 under the NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License. It has 30B total parameters with about 3.5B active per token (128 routed experts plus one shared expert, six activated per token, across 52 total layers: 23 Mamba-2, 23 MoE and 6 attention), a default 256K-token context window configurable up to 1M tokens, and generates a reasoning trace before its final answer with support for function calling and structured outputs. NVIDIA reports the model matches or exceeds the accuracy of similarly sized open models such as Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 and GPT-OSS-20B while delivering substantially higher inference throughput.
advantages: Scored 89.1% on AIME25 without tool use, and 99.2% with tools enabled, in reasoning-on mode (Hugging Face model card).
Scored 78.3% on MMLU-Pro (Hugging Face model card).
Scored 92.9% on the RULER-100 long-context benchmark at 256K tokens, and 86.3% at the full 1M-token context (Hugging Face model card).
NVIDIA reports up to 3.3x higher inference throughput than Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 at matching or better accuracy (NVIDIA Hugging Face blog post).
disadvantages: No vision support; documented multilingual coverage is limited to English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Italian (Hugging Face model card).
use_cases: Building AI agents with tool use and structured outputs
Long-context retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) up to 1M tokens
Multi-step reasoning, coding and math problem solving

sources.title: Nemotron 3 Nano: A new standard for efficient, open, and intelligent agentic models
Nemotron Nano 3 30B - Amazon Bedrock model card

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens (256000/262144) matches the model's default 256K context configuration; NVIDIA's Hugging Face card states the model supports up to 1M tokens in an extended configuration, but the catalog's lower figure is kept per instructions and the 1M figure is mentioned only descriptively. Catalog's max_output_tokens (8000/8192) matches AWS Bedrock's listed 8K max output for nvidia.nemotron-nano-3-30b. No vision support is documented, consistent with the catalog's text-only modality. Corrected the license name to its exact title, 'NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License'. Corrected the layer count: the model card's own clarifying sentence states 52 total layers (23 Mamba-2, 23 MoE, 6 attention); the original phrasing '23 Mamba-2/MoE layers' undercounted the non-attention layers by half.
